name: Foxen
positioning: A multifamily compliance platform for renters insurance, rent reporting and pet policy enforcement.
description: Foxen is a compliance platform for multifamily owners and operators, sold as three insurance-compliance tiers (WaiverCore, WaiverCell, WaiverFlex) that verify and monitor renters insurance certificates around the clock, plus two resident-facing modules: Rentistry, which reports rent payments to Experian, Equifax and TransUnion to help residents build credit, and PetClear, which centralizes pet records and screens emotional-support-animal claims. The platform integrates with major property management systems including Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, MRI, Rent Manager and ResMan.
real_estate_use: A property manager uses Foxen to stop chasing residents for proof of renters insurance: the platform verifies certificates of insurance on upload and monitors them continuously, auto-enrolling a resident in a liability waiver the moment a coverage gap appears instead of leaving the property exposed. The same account can turn on Rentistry so on-time rent gets reported to the credit bureaus as a resident perk, and PetClear to check an emotional-support-animal claim before it is accepted.
features: 24/7 certificate-of-insurance monitoring with automatic waiver enrollment on coverage gaps
Rentistry rent-payment reporting to Experian, Equifax and TransUnion
PetClear pet record management and ESA claim screening
Integrations with Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, MRI, Rent Manager and ResMan
